definitions.explanation: Describes something that lacks aesthetic refinement or shows poor judgment in taste. Can refer to choices in fashion, decor, humor, or behavior.

examples.japanese: {悪趣味|あくしゅみ}な{冗談|じょうだん}
その{服|ふく}の{組|く}み{合|あ}わせは{悪趣味|あくしゅみ}だ。
examples.english: That outfit combination is in poor taste.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}の{不幸|ふこう}を{笑|わら}うなんて、{悪趣味|あくしゅみ}にも{程|ほど}がある。
examples.english: Laughing at others' misfortune is terribly tasteless.

notes:
FORMATION: {悪|あく} (bad) + {趣味|しゅみ} (taste, hobby)

NUANCE: {悪趣味|あくしゅみ} can describe both aesthetic failures (garish clothes, tacky decor) and moral/social failures (inappropriate jokes, morbid interests). It carries a judgmental tone.

CAN FUNCTION AS: Na-adjective ({悪趣味|あくしゅみ}な...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪趣味|あくしゅみ}な{冗談|じょうだん} (joke in bad taste)
- {悪趣味|あくしゅみ}な{趣味|しゅみ} (morbid hobby)
- {悪趣味|あくしゅみ}にも{程|ほど}がある (that's going too far in bad taste)

RELATED WORDS:
- {下品|げひん} (vulgar, crude)
- {趣味|しゅみ}が{悪|わる}い (to have bad taste)
- {無粋|ぶすい} (boorish, uncouth)
